```{r, echo = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(downloadthis)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(duckdb)

# Analysts change this path as necessary

db_path <- "I:/Enrgy_div/SEO/CleanEnegyTechUnit/CET Projects/Data Repository/generator_database_shared/generator_database_dbt/dev.duckdb"

db <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), db_path, read_only = TRUE)

today <- format(Sys.Date(), format = "%m-%d-%Y")

# change the year paramater in the where statement as needed
storage_query <- dbSendQuery(
  db, 
  "
  SELECT *, 
    nameplate_mw * 1000 AS kwac
  FROM main.mart_combined__storage_capacity 
  WHERE year_interconnected <= 2024
  "
  )

storage <- dbFetch(storage_query) |> 
  tibble() 

dbClearResult(storage_query)
dbDisconnect(db, shutdown = TRUE)

total_storage <- paste(round(sum(storage$kwac, na.rm = T)/1000, digits = 2), "MW", sep = " ")

top_year <- max(as.numeric(storage$year_interconnected), na.rm = TRUE)

bottom_year <- max(as.numeric(storage$year_interconnected), na.rm = TRUE) - 10

year_limit <- max(as.numeric(storage$year_interconnected), na.rm = TRUE) + 3


cumulative_storage <- storage |> 
  group_by(year_interconnected) |> 
  summarise(total_mwac = sum(kwac) / 1000) |> 
  mutate(cumulative_mwac = cumsum(total_mwac), 
         total_label = ifelse(year_interconnected == max(year_interconnected), total_storage, ""))

p <- cumulative_storage |> 
  mutate(year_interconnected = as.numeric(year_interconnected)) |> 
  ggplot() + aes(x = year_interconnected, y = cumulative_mwac) + geom_line(color = "#0D5257", size = 1) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(bottom_year, top_year + 3), breaks = seq(bottom_year, top_year, by = 5), name = "Year") + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = total_label), nudge_x = 1) + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) + ylab("Cumulative Storage Capacity (MW)") + 
  labs(caption = paste0("Source: Minnesota Public Utilities Commision Annual Distributed Generation Reports,\nEnergy Information Administration Form EIA-860\nAccessed ", today))
 
p

p |> 
  download_this(
    output_name = "Cumulative Storage Capacity", 
    output_extension = ".png", 
    button_label = "Download Plot",
    button_type = "success", 
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```
